typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEMBER_BAL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT right(replicate(\'0\',12) + CAST(COUNT(*)AS VARCHAR(20)),12) AS MEMBER_BAL  FROM dbo.STAGE_MEMBER_DETAIL a WHERE a.BATCH_ID = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCMEMBERBAL
OLESRCMEMBERBAL derive(V_SNPSHT_DATE = $V_SNPSHT_DATE,
		FILE_PREFIX = 'MBR  D7',
		V_SERVICE_DATE = $V_SERVICE_DATE,
		FILE_SUFFIX = ' 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00                    ') ~> DERADDSNPSHTDATE
DERADDSNPSHTDATE sink(input(
		MEMBER_BAL as string,
		SNPSHT_DTE as string,
		FILE_PREFIX as string,
		SERVICE_DATE as string,
		FILE_SUFFIX as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_BAL,
		SNPSHT_DTE = V_SNPSHT_DATE,
		FILE_PREFIX,
		SERVICE_DATE = V_SERVICE_DATE,
		FILE_SUFFIX)) ~> FFDMEMBERBAL
